ios.desc:
No Signal? No Problem. 

MeshGrid is a professional tactical mapping and team communication app designed for the most challenging environments where cellular networks completely fail.
By connecting to custom MeshGrid Nodes (learn more at meshgrid.org) via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), the app unifies real-time location tracking, secure mesh messaging, and advanced tactical tools into a single, reliable interface.

WHO IS IT FOR?
• Search and Rescue (SAR) & Disaster Response Teams
• Field Crews, Outdoor Professionals & Security Personnel
• Off-Grid Explorers, Hikers & Tactical Teams

KEY FEATURES

Tactical Mapping & Live Tracking
• High-Performance Maps: Mapbox-powered terrain styles with north-lock and specialized tactical themes.
• Live Team Tracking: Monitor your team’s positions in real time across the mesh network with custom callsigns and colors.
• Professional Navigation: Full support for MGRS, UTM, and Graticule grids.

Mission Planning & Drawing Tools
• Tactical Drawing: Draw squares, circles, lines, and SAR-style hatched search areas on the map.
• Smart Syncing: Sync shapes across the mesh network while keeping detailed patterns local to save bandwidth and ensure privacy.
• Operational Alerts: Instantly drop markers and notes to highlight critical field information.

Reliable Mesh Messaging
• Offline Communication: Channel-based or direct messaging via MeshGrid Nodes with persistent history.
• Enhanced Security: Upgraded MeshKeyStore protects your security credentials and encryption keys during updates.
• Streamlined UI: Redesigned chat interface with a single "Send" button for fast, high-stress communication.

Offline First Aid & Survival Guides
• 100% Offline Protocols: Step-by-step emergency guides designed for rapid response in high-stress scenarios.
• Global Access: Life-saving knowledge base available in over 20 languages.

Global Localization & Maps
• 22+ Languages & RTL: Full support for English, Turkish, Arabic (with native RTL layout), Ukrainian, Japanese, and more.
• Offline Map Downloads: Save entire regions to your device before heading into zero-connectivity zones.
• Live Weather Overlays: Access radar, wind, and pressure layers when internet is available to plan ahead.

Privacy & Reliability First
• No Account Required: Local-first data architecture. Your data belongs to you.
• GDPR Compliant: Professional settings to customize location reporting frequency, units, and privacy.

SAFETY NOTICE:
MeshGrid depends on real-world radio range

quotes.text: I built Meshgrid because I wanted a reliable way to communicate when internet access is spotty or non-existent. It’s a pure P2P mesh implementation for iOS. I spent a lot of time optimizing the low-level socket handling to ensure the app remains stable under heavy peer load without hitting memory limits. Open to any technical questions about the networking stack! https://meshgrid.org
